record.paper_title: Model Theory of Tame Valued Fields and Beyond: Recent Developments and Open Questions
record.context_brief: Extremality of the coarse component in a composition of valuations
record.original_question: A valued field (K, v) is called extremal if for every multivariate polynomial f(X_1,...,X_n) over K, the set {v(f(a_1,...,a_n)) | a_i in O_K} has a maximal element in vK union {infinity}. A valuation v can be written as a composition v = w ∘ w-bar, meaning w is a coarsening of v and w-bar is the valuation induced by v on the residue field Kw of w. It is known that if v = w ∘ w-bar is extremal, then the finer component w-bar is also extremal. Does it follow that the coarser component w is also extremal?

evidence.quote: Open problem 12: We know that if v = w ∘ w-bar is extremal, then so is w-bar (see [6, Lemma 4.1]). But does it also follow that w is extremal?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A valued field $(K,v)$ consists of a field $K$ together with a valuation $v\colon K\to vK\cup\{\infty\}$, where $vK$ is the value group and $\mathcal{O}_K=\{a\in K:v(a)\geq 0\}$ is the valuation ring. The field $(K,v)$ is called extremal if for every $n\geq 1$ and every polynomial $f(X_1,\dots,X_n)\in K[X_1,\dots,X_n]$, the set
$$\{v(f(a_1,\dots,a_n)) : a_1,\dots,a_n\in\mathcal{O}_K\}\subseteq vK\cup\{\infty\}$$
attains a maximum.

A coarsening of $v$ is a valuation $w$ on $K$ whose valuation ring contains $\mathcal{O}_K$. Given such a coarsening $w$, the valuation $v$ induces a valuation $\overline{w}$ on the residue field $Kw$ of $w$, and one writes $v=w\circ\overline{w}$.

It is known that if $v=w\circ\overline{w}$ and $(K,v)$ is extremal, then the induced valued residue field $(Kw,\overline{w})$ is extremal.

Question: Does it follow, under the same hypothesis, that the coarsening $(K,w)$ is also extremal?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is listed as an open problem in a recent (2025) survey on the model theory of tame valued fields. The standard references on extremal valued fields (Azgin–Kuhlmann–Pop and Kuhlmann's "Notes on extremal and tame valued fields") establish that the finer component $\overline{w}$ inherits extremality, but no published result is found establishing or refuting extremality of the coarsening $w$.

status_evidence.title: Notes on extremal and tame valued fields
status_evidence.snippet: Compositions of valuations are considered; extremality of the finer component is shown, while certain composition statements remain open.
status_evidence.claim: Existing literature treats compositions of extremal valuations and shows extremality passes to the finer component, leaving the coarsening question unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Characterization of extremal valued fields
status_evidence.snippet: Characterization of extremal valued fields with perfect residue field; uses compositions of valuations.
status_evidence.claim: Known characterization results do not address whether the coarsening of a composition that is extremal must itself be extremal.
